01-intro: A sales lead and a younger sales colleague, a woman and a man in their late twenties to mid thirties in modern work-casual clothes, stand by a tall window in a bright sales office and talk through how to answer a customer's objection before a call; she holds a slim playbook folder with a plain pastel cover, he listens with a coffee cup in hand, both relaxed and smiling.
02-cowork: The regional manager for Northern Europe at a Nordic outdoor-gear retailer, a woman in her early thirties in modern work-casual clothes, stands in the bright showroom of the regional office between open rails of mid-layer fleeces and trail jackets in muted pastel colours with plain tags, talking with a male colleague in his late twenties who holds a folded fleece; both are smiling.
04-cs-tools: Two IT help desk technicians of a logistics company, a woman and a man in their early thirties in modern work-casual clothes, talk at a light-oak standing table by a tall window in a bright help desk area; she holds a headset in one hand and gestures as she explains, he listens with a smile, a green plant beside them, and through the window plain white delivery vans wait far away in a warehouse yard, softly out of focus, with no badge, emblem or number plate.
05-cs-advanced: Two colleagues of the same company, a woman and a man in their early thirties in modern work-casual clothes with small carry-on suitcases, chat and smile on a bright, modern glass-roofed train platform in Vienna before their business trip to Budapest, no signs or departure boards in view.
06-cs-gh-copilot: At the light-oak tasting table of a bright Aurora Provisions tasting room, a sales rep in her early thirties in modern work-casual clothes sets out small bowls of aged mountain cheese, black garlic mustard and apricot preserve for a restaurant customer, a man in his late thirties, who tries a sample while both smile; plain jars with blank kraft labels stand on open shelves softly blurred behind them.
08-ai-teammates: At the quarterly supplier review, a procurement team lead in her early thirties in modern work-casual clothes welcomes a supplier account manager in his late thirties with a handshake in a bright lobby with light-oak benches and green plants; she holds a slim folder with a plain cover under her arm, and both smile as they turn toward the meeting room.
